title: Open Well Data: public subsurface data for oil, gas and CCS (code, catalogue and site)
description: Open Well Data is a tool that helps researchers, operators and regulators find and use public data. It indexes public subsurface data sources for oil, gas and CCS (wireline logs, drilling, production, seismic, CO2 storage) with a verification status and date per record, and ships the openwelldata Python package: readers that return standard channel names in standard units, recipes for datasets that cannot be redistributed, a variable index, and an MCP server.
